packet_defects_found.finding: classifier.sql under-matches by design and the packet says so, but the gap is larger than a footnote: `^UTV2-[0-9]+` and `^utv2-` both require a hyphen immediately after UTV2 and are ^-anchored, so the entire 'UTV2 <space> Proof Player <hex>' CLV-harness family and all mid-string '[utv2-<issue>-<run>]' / '(utv2-<issue>-<run>)' run tags escape into the legitimate bucket. Measured: 23 rows, several settled with stake 1.00, directly contaminating ROI. Closed here by the [ _-] character class plus bracketed/parenthesised run-tag patterns.

false-positive-audit.md section 1c uses 'has player_id populated' as structural counter-evidence that a row is real (12 in the legitimate bucket, 0 in the fixture bucket). All 12 are in fact `UTV2 Proof Player` fixtures that the hyphen-anchored regex missed. player_id is not a realness signal. The audit's overall conclusion was still correct; this supporting signal was not. After this classifier, retained_with_player_id = 0.

The three-valued-logic trap the packet documents (411 rows where the raw OR-chain evaluates to SQL NULL, so `WHERE NOT (predicate)` drops them from BOTH sides) is a property of the OR-chain shape itself. Reconfirmed at exactly 411 rows on 2026-07-31.
packet_defects_found.action: structurally_eliminated: the classifier is a CASE returning a reason code, retention is IS NULL and exclusion is IS NOT NULL, which are total and mutually exclusive by construction; the migration additionally aborts in-transaction if retained + excluded != raw

reversibility.rollback_restores_prior_behaviour_exactl: DROP SCHEMA reporting CASCADE removes the entire surface. No object outside `reporting` is created or altered, and the dependency direction is reporting -> public only, so consumers reading public.* are unaffected before, during and after. The down script guards this: it counts cross-schema dependents and raises rather than cascading into public.
reversibility.round_trip_drill_note: No Docker or psql available locally. migration-reversibility-gate.yml runs the drill on scratch postgres:16. The migration's fail-closed partition guard is conditioned on v_raw > 0 so a replay against an empty database does not abort -- a defect caught and fixed before commit.

downstream.dependency: least-privilege read-only Postgres role, granted SELECT on this view
grant_statements: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reporting TO <readonly_role>;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA reporting TO <readonly_role>;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA reporting GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO <readonly_role>;
downstream.design_note: Views are deliberately NOT security_invoker. The base tables have RLS enabled and are owned by postgres, so security-definer views let the role read the reporting surface with no grant at all on public.* -- the least-privilege property UTV2-1633 needs. The role must not be granted anything on public or it regains a path to the contaminated tables.
downstream.naming_note: A dedicated `reporting` schema (rather than public.reporting_picks etc.) makes the grant a single schema-level statement, keeps every object removable by one DROP SCHEMA, and keeps the objects outside the public-only Live Schema Parity comparison surface.

governance_finding.title: The concurrency governor cannot see lanes whose manifests live only on unmerged branches
governance_finding.detail: scripts/ops/shared.ts readAllManifests() reads only the local filesystem docs/06_status/lanes/*.json. UTV2-1604's manifest exists solely on its PR branch codex/utv2-1604-parked-mode-scheduler-policy and is therefore invisible from any other checkout. Running `ops:lane-start UTV2-1399` would have been MECHANICALLY ADMITTED -- the governor would have seen only two governance lanes and raised no forbidden_combination violation -- while SUBSTANTIVELY violating the ["migration","runtime"] rule. Four of the six currently active worktrees (UTV2-1594, 1613, 1624, 1632) likewise have no committed manifest, so the governor is blind to most of the live board.
governance_finding.action_taken: Did not lane-start. The mechanical loophole was not used; the substantive rule was honoured. Recommend a governor change that resolves active lanes from open PRs / remote branches rather than the local working tree alone.

corrected_inventory.headline_recommendation: Scope any future deletion to class `ci` only. The 6 qa_demo picks are the sole source of all 16 command_center_delivery_mappings rows, and that table has no CREATE TABLE in the migration ledger — deleting them would mutate a table the repo cannot replay.
